description: Edit a Napkin doc. For a change to existing prose use `edits` — a list of exact find/replace pairs, which is the SAFEST option and the one to reach for by default: it leaves everything you did not target untouched, and it fails loudly rather than clobbering a doc somebody else is typing in. `append` adds a section at the end. `body` replaces the WHOLE document and should be a last resort. Also retitle, describe, set visibility, or `archived` (true takes it out of the gallery, false brings it back). Read the doc with napkin_docs_get first — `edits` match the current text exactly. Doc ids come from napkin_docs_list.

append.description: Markdown appended to the end (own paragraph).

approvalId.description: Approval id from a prior needs_confirmation response. Omit on the first call.

body.description: Full replacement markdown body. Prefer `edits` — this overwrites everything. Write each paragraph as ONE long line; the editor wraps it for the reader.

edits.description: Targeted find/replace pairs, applied in order. All must match or none are applied.

find.description: Exact text to replace, copied verbatim from the current body. Must appear EXACTLY ONCE — include surrounding words when a phrase repeats.

replace.description: What to put there. Empty string deletes.

visibility.description: Who can see it: PRIVATE (only the user), WORKSPACE (every member, the default), or SHARED (specific people, granted afterwards). Say 'make it private' → PRIVATE.

workspace.description: Workspace slug. Personal tokens with no default workspace MUST pass this; tokens with a default can override per call. Ignored for workspace API keys.

name: napkin_docs_update
